cases.prompt: Design a REST API for a library app with books, members and loans.
expectations: Uses plural noun resources (books, members, loans) with HTTP methods expressing actions.
Gives status codes such as 201 for create and 404 for missing resources.
List endpoints use a pagination envelope or parameters.

cases.prompt:
Review my endpoints:
POST /getUsers
GET /deleteUser?id=5
POST /user/update
expectations: Explains that verbs belong in the HTTP method, not the path.
Points out GET must not delete, since GET is safe and may be cached or prefetched.
Proposes GET /users, DELETE /users/{id}, and PATCH or PUT /users/{id}.
